description: Manage your WallSign digital signage network: players, contents, channels, layouts and schedules.

interface.longDescription:
Manage your digital signage network by simply asking.

Check on your screens without opening a dashboard: ask which players are offline, which ones are waiting to sync, or which run an outdated app version, and get a clear answer in seconds. You can look at a player's status, connection and diagnostics, or request a fresh screenshot to see what it is showing.

Make everyday changes in plain language. Tag players, contents and channels; add contents to a channel or rearrange its playlist; create schedules and assign them; choose which layouts a player uses; and set brightness, language, time zone or power-on hours across many screens at once.

For changes that touch many screens, you get a preview first: what will change, what stays the same and what cannot be applied. You confirm before anything is saved. Updates reach your screens only when you ask to publish them, never automatically.

Your account is respected: you see only your organization's data, and every change requires the same permissions you already have in the web app.
defaultPrompt: Which of my players are offline right now?
List all my players with their model and app version.
Show me the schedules defined in my account.
